name: couchbase-mobile
description: Build a fully functioning always-on mobile app (iOS/Swift or Android/Kotlin) that keeps running with no internet connectivity. Provisions a Capella App Services backend — app data, users, roles, and access-control functions — then generates a runnable Couchbase Lite app with bidirectional cloud-to-edge data sync that reconciles when it reconnects.

interface.shortDescription: Build an always-on mobile app (iOS or Android) that runs with no connectivity and syncs to Capella App Services.
defaultPrompt: I want to build a Couchbase Mobile app.
Build an always-on iOS app that syncs with Couchbase Capella App Services.
Build an always-on Android app that syncs with Couchbase Capella App Services.
Provision a Capella App Services backend for my mobile app and generate the client.
